desc: Ideation: fix indexing convention (`dist[i]` = root distance of i‑th chain node; `length = dist[k] - dist[start]`, `nodes = k - start + 1`) and confirm only the maximal window per endpoint is needed.
Implement full solution: adjacency build + iterative DFS with enter/exit frames, `lastIdx` list, `dist` stack, per‑frame `start`, and tie‑break answer update initialized to `[0, 1]`.
Validate on Example 1 → `[6,2]` and Example 2 → `[0,1]`; hand‑trace verified the off‑by‑one convention (root: `L=0,cnt=1`; node 5: `L=6,cnt=2`; node 4: `L=6,cnt=3` correctly rejected).

Edge cases reasoned: iterative DFS handles depth 5·10⁴ path graphs (no recursion limit); all-equal values yield `[0,1]` per Example 2 logic; per-frame `start` plus `lastIdx`/`dist` restoration keeps siblings independent.
Complexity confirmed O(n) time / O(n) space; final `class Solution` returns a plain 2-element list — no further optimization needed.
